title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
reflections: A slow burn that rewards patience. The ecological worldbuilding stuck with me more than the politics.

title: Childhood's End
author: Arthur C. Clarke
reflections: Unsettling ending. Made me think about what 'progress' actually costs a species.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
reflections: Le Guin builds an entire society around a single 'what if' and never loses the human core of it.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
reflections: Dense and disorienting in the best way. You can feel the whole cyberpunk genre being invented in real time.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
reflections: Quietly devastating. The restraint in the prose makes the horror land harder.
